notes: 1. When RESET is released, the functionality is guaranteed down to VBOR0 min.

2. This formula has to be applied only on the power supplies related to the I/O structure described by the pin definition table. The maximum I/O input voltage is the smallest value between Min (VDD, VDDA) + 3.6 V and 5.5 V.
3. For operation with voltage higher than Min (VDD, VDDA) + 0.3 V, the internal pull‑up and pull‑down resistors must be disabled.
